component.name: EV Battery SOH
component.summary: State of Health analyzer, electrochemical degradation forecaster & certified inspector for electric vehicles

description.p: EV Battery SOH is a telemetric battery health assessment suite for electric vehicles (Tesla, Stellantis, Renault, VW Group, MG, Hyundai, Kia, etc.).

It models capacity degradation using non-parametric Gaussian local regression (LOWESS) with 95% confidence intervals, captures Arrhenius thermal wear kinetics and DC fast-charging severity, projects future degradation scenarios (Optimistic, Realistic, Severe), and generates tamper-evident, cryptographically signed PDF inspection certificates with offline QR verification.
